entries.appliesTo: the administration of each institution under the Campus Accountability and Safety Act (Louisiana postsecondary institutions)

sources.curriculum: § 3399.16(A) — 'the administration of each institution, in consultation with campus or local law enforcement agencies, shall develop and distribute, not less than four times per academic year through in-person or online delivery or both, information to students regarding power-based violence, campus safety, and internet and cell phone safety'

flags: AI content is definitional only: § 3399.12(5)(b) adds to the power-based violence definition 'Any conduct prohibited by R.S. 14:73.13 or 73.14, or any successor statute, involving media generated by artificial intelligence or deepfake media depicting sexual imagery' — no AI-specific compliance duty is imposed by this act
Bill binds postsecondary institutions (R.S. 17:3399.12/3399.16, Campus Accountability and Safety Act), not K-12 schools; education-k12 is the only education family in the v1.0 vocabulary

Safety-education distribution duty fits no listed duty key (§ 3399.16(A) develop-and-distribute at least four times per academic year; § 3399.16(C)(1) 'distributed as part of new student orientation and shall be posted on an easily accessible page of each institution's website'; § 3399.16(C)(2) 'If the student receiving the information required by Subsections B and C of this Section is a minor, the information shall also be provided to his parent or legal guardian') — coded param curriculum=required as the closest fit, lossy
No penalty or enforcement provision in this text; exposure omitted (silence is silence)
